They demand consumer choice and lower prices for the blended fuel.

title: At last minute, Udhayanidhi taken to Sengipatti police stn for grilling; huge crowd gathers

title: India paves way for return of merchant fees on UPI; what it means
description: Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) is the fee merchants pay to banks and payment service providers for processing digital transactions. In India, credit card payments generally attract an MDR of around 1.5%.

title: 'Madrassa pass-outs develop terrorist-like mindset': UP deputy CM Keshav Maurya
description: Speaking to reporters at Vidhan Bhavan, Maurya alleged that madrassa students do not express patriotic slogans and linked their education to extremism. "Anyone who receives a madrassa education does not chant 'Bharat Mata Ki Jai' nor sing 'Vande Mataram', and develops a terrorist-like mindset," he was quoted as saying by news agency PTI. The remarks were strongly criticised by senior Samajwadi Party leader Shivpal Yadav.

title: Boy with heart condition signs with Panthers and scores NFL touchdown
description: Six-year-old Asher Harvey, who was born with a complex heart condition and has undergone multiple heart surgeries, fulfilled his dream of becoming a Carolina Panthers player for a day through Make-A-Wish. He signed a one-day contract, met quarterback Bryce Young, joined team activities and scored a touchdown during Fan Fest, giving his family a joyful milestone after years of medical challenges.

title: California replants 71,000 trees across massive Ranch Fire scar
description: Eight years after California's devastating Ranch Fire burned more than 459,000 acres, the US Forest Service and partner organisations planted 71,000 conifer seedlings in just eight days. The reforestation effort is part of a long-term plan to restore damaged forest, reduce future wildfire risk and support natural recovery across the Mendocino National Forest.

title: Drone hunters: How helicopters are becoming the battlefield's new predator
description: Modern battlefields face a significant drone proliferation challenge globally.  Affordable weapons and guided rockets are being adapted for drone interception.  Helicopters are emerging as ideal platforms for effective counter-drone operations.  India is developing indigenous solutions for drone warfare capabilities.  These adaptations aim to address the economic disparity in modern air combat.

title: ‘Respectful language should sill be maintained’: Ex-India captain on PM Modi abuse
description: Former India football captain Bhaichung Bhutia said citizens have the right to protest but should avoid abusive language, especially against the Prime Minister. Manu Bhaker also urged youngsters to use respectful words. Prime Minister Narendra Modi, meanwhile, said he did not want the protesters punished, calling their actions mistakes and hoping they would learn from them.

title: IAF seeks new high-power sniper rifle for its Garud special forces
description: The Indian Air Force is seeking a new .50 BMG sniper rifle for its Garud Special Forces. This advanced weapon will significantly extend their engagement distances and anti-material capabilities. The Garuds will also receive accompanying equipment like suppressors and thermal scopes. Additionally, the air force is looking for indigenous man-portable loitering munitions for precision strikes. These acquisitions aim to enhance the Garud commandos' operational effectiveness and independent strike power.

title: Rangers, Canadiens emerge as top landing spots for ex-Kraken $6.95m winger
description: Eeli Tolvanen recorded an impressive performance in the last season with the Seattle Kraken before his contract expired. Ahead of training camp, New York Rangers and the Montreal Canadiens have been linked to him.

title: Scientists discover Greenland sharks can see for centuries, debunking blindness myth
description: Recent studies reveal that Greenland sharks possess well-preserved visual systems that can last for centuries, challenging the previous notion that they were nearly blind. Research shows that their eyes are uniquely suited for low-light environments, demonstrating impressive adaptability. Scientists found healthy rod cells and active genes responsible for light detection, indicating these sharks have a remarkable ability to maintain their eyesight throughout their extended lifespans.

title: 'Private media entity organising it': Govt says 'no role' in Hasina's Aug 5 event
description: The MEA stated no government involvement in a private media event.  The proposed forum concerns former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.  Bangladesh sought clarification from India regarding its support for the event.  Hasina resigned in August 2024 and has been living in Delhi.  She faces a death sentence for crimes against humanity.

title: 'Insult to nation': Mamata attacks BJP over Netaji remarks, armtwisting TMC leaders
'Who is PM Modi to forgive?' Rahul says students 'need apology not forgiveness'

Behind every young life lost is a family carrying pain that will never leave them - and serious questions about a broken education system,” Gandhi said in a post on X where he also shared images of his interaction with parents and students.

title: '2k samples tested': Govt dismisses fuel adulteration claims, says only 2 cases found
description: The Ministry of Petroleum has rolled out enhanced fuel quality measures, implementing water ingress testing that occurs multiple times a day at various fuel stations. In a comprehensive assessment, more than two thousand samples were analyzed for contaminants, revealing minimal problems. Sales were promptly halted at locations with verified contamination. The Ministry warns that stringent penalties will be enforced against any future instances of adulteration.

title: 'Never got the credit he deserved': Gavaskar compares Rahane to Dravid
description: Sunil Gavaskar lauded Ajinkya Rahane's leadership during India's historic Australia tour victory. Rahane captained the team through significant challenges and injuries to secure a remarkable series win. Gavaskar noted Rahane's exceptional captaincy record, which often went unappreciated by the public. He highlighted Rahane's crucial century after a devastating defeat, inspiring a comeback. Rahane departs cricket with immense respect from all involved in the sport.

title: Crackdown on digital fraud: SC orders action, gives strict directions to RBI
Spices coated in cloth dye, talcum powder? Hyderabad raids expose food adulteration
description: Over 25,000 kg of hazardous chemical-laced spices were seized during raids. Three people were arrested after inspections uncovered alarming non-compliance with food safety laws. Dangerous practices involved synthetic chemicals, cloth dyes, and shining powder in spices. Strict legal proceedings are initiated against violating business owners under the Food Safety Act. Enforcement drives will continue to ensure safe, unadulterated food products reach consumers.

title: 'Answered public discontent with bullets': MEA slams Pak over 'farce' PoK polls
description: In a strong statement, the Ministry of External Affairs demanded action against cross-border terrorism, directly targeting groups like Lashkar-e-Taiba following claims about Indian agencies taking down their commanders. They lambasted the local elections in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir as illegitimate, citing repression of civilians by Pakistani forces. Moreover, India urged the global community to address Pakistan's actions firmly.

title: 'Will do whatever is necessary': India after Pak deploys 250 Chinese Howitzers
description: India stated it will protect national interests after Pakistan deployed Chinese artillery guns.  Pakistan has reportedly deployed around 250 Chinese-made SH-15 artillery systems.  India criticized Pakistan's recent elections in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir as a farce.  The spokesperson noted civilian deaths during a crackdown in the region.  Both nations continue to modernize their respective artillery capabilities.

title: 26-year-old champion boxer arrested in Athens suitcase death probe
description: Greek police have arrested champion boxer Sharif Ahmadzai over the death of Scottish charity worker Elisabeth-Jane Ross, whose body was found in a suitcase in Athens. Investigators say CCTV footage, ATM withdrawals using Ross's bank cards and witness testimony linked the 26-year-old to the case. Authorities are continuing forensic tests to determine Ross's cause of death while the homicide investigation proceeds.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school in 2016; 10 yrs later, it closed after $125m funding
description: The Primary School, a tuition-free institution, will close in June after a decade of operation. This school provided education, healthcare, and family support to low-income children. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative will not continue funding beyond the upcoming academic year. Academic results remained below state averages, prompting the board's decision. The initiative pledged fifty million dollars to aid the transition for affected students.

The state CID investigation is gathering pace with several arrests made.  Former CM Raghubar Das urged dialogue and a CBI inquiry for justice.  The indefinite sit-in continues, with protesters vowing to escalate their agitation.

title: 'Resign, I'll accept within minutes': DKS' blunt warning to disgruntled Cong MLAs
description: In a firm address, Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar cautioned discontented Congress MLAs about the implications of resigning, promising quick acceptance of any such moves. He emphasized the importance of loyalty and patience, drawing from his personal political experiences to underline perseverance. After being sidelined in the recent ministry expansion, two MLAs opted to resign. Shivakumar pledged to create opportunities in state-run boards for those omitted.

title: All about Bradley Cooper and Gigi Hadid’s relationship
description: In 2023, Bradley Cooper and Gigi Hadid ignited a romance that blossomed over the years. Their public appearances increased in 2024 as they were spotted at award shows and Broadway. By 2025, conversations about marriage began, signaling a serious commitment. In 2026, wedding speculation surged after they were observed wearing matching bands, hinting at their intentions for a shared future.

title: Salman Khan explains sohail khan-seema sajdeh divorce, urges brother not to blame himself
description: During an episode of Alliance, Salman Khan candidly spoke about his brother Sohail Khan's tumultuous marriage to Seema Sajdeh. He expressed admiration for Sohail's attempts to keep their bond intact, emphasizing the emotional toll it took on him. Salman reflected on his initial apprehensions about being on the same platform while addressing Seema's recent comments labeling their marriage as toxic. Still, he found solace in their newfound amicable co-parenting dynamic.

title: 'Sadhu-saint not involved': CM Yogi on Ram Mandir donation theft case
description: Addressing reporters, CM Yogi said said the initial SIT report had not found any involvement of religious figures in the alleged theft of offerings made at the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Temple. "No involvement of any sadhu-saint was found in the SIT's initial report in the case related to the alleged embezzlement of offerings (chadhava) at the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Temple," he said.

title: Rs 15.56 crore: The money behind the medal at 2026 CWG
description: India's 39-medal Commonwealth Games campaign highlighted the impact of the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS), which funds elite athletes through customised training, competition exposure and sports science support. This TimesofIndia.com explainer details how athletes are selected, funded and reviewed, while outlining the government's enhanced investment in high-performance sport as India builds towards the 2036 Games ambitions.

title: As France sees its first fire cloud, should India be worried?
description: France witnessed its first pyrocumulonimbus fire cloud event in July 2026.  This phenomenon occurs when intense wildfires create their own thunderstorms.  India's rising temperatures and dry spells increase forest fire frequency.  While India has not reported fire clouds, its forests are becoming more flammable.  The Himalayan pine belt presents the highest potential for such an event in India.

title: From sugar subsidies to PLI schemes, here's what New Delhi is defending at WTO
description: India currently defends nine trade disputes at the World Trade Organization.  The government has spent approximately Rs 2.43 crore on legal services for these cases.  Japan, China, the EU, Brazil, and Australia are among the challenging countries.  Disputes involve steel imports, sugar support, and ICT tariffs.  China also challenges India's production-linked incentive schemes and technology measures.

title: Amazon shares fall as market cap crosses $3tn, analysts link it to Jeff Bezos
description: Amazon briefly surpassed three trillion dollars in market value. Founder Jeff Bezos plans to sell fifteen million shares valued at over four billion dollars. This sale follows a strong second-quarter earnings report for the e-commerce giant. Bezos has previously sold significant amounts of Amazon stock since 2002. His remaining stake in the company remains substantial despite these transactions.

title: Haryana wins medals, Gujarat wins projects: Hooda's swipe over CWG 2030 host pick
description: Congress MP Deepender Hooda proposed Haryana as host for the 2030 Commonwealth Games. He highlighted Haryana's significant contribution to India's medal tally in sports. Hooda stated that Haryana has secured over fifty percent of India's medals. He urged the government to invest sports infrastructure in Haryana. The MP also criticized the concentration of projects in Gujarat.

title: 'India in a tough position': Ex-cricketer sounds WTC qualification warning
description: India's World Test Championship final hopes depend on the Sri Lanka series. A 2-0 loss would significantly hinder qualification prospects for the Indian team. Winning the series 2-0 improves India's standing but not dramatically. Upcoming away series in New Zealand and Australia present further challenges. India faces a tough schedule with little room for error ahead.

title: 'Many friends yet to return': Patna students restart protest over NEET stir crackdown
description: The demonstrators demanded immediate release of all students still in jail and the withdrawal of criminal cases registered against those arrested during the statewide agitation. "We want a verified list of those who have been released from jail and those who are still behind bars after being arrested during the protests," one of the protesters said. A student activist from Siwan also alleged excessive use of force during earlier protests.

title: Centre moves Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, proposes major reforms
description: The government has unveiled a progressive bill introducing substantial tax reforms and incentives designed to stimulate investment and enhance the electronics manufacturing sector. Key features include extended tax exemptions for capital goods supplied to local manufacturers and streamlined digital payment regulations. Furthermore, it aims to provide relief to business trusts while replacing an existing ordinance and ensuring consultations with stakeholders are integrated into the legislative process.

title: 'Cricket has an alcohol culture, not just England': Ben Stokes
description: Ben Stokes believes cricket's drinking culture is deeply embedded across all levels.  He stated this culture has not changed despite increased professionalism in the sport.  This discussion follows a recent disciplinary issue involving team curfew breaches.  Stokes and teammate Gus Atkinson faced suspension for a late-night outing.  The ECB subsequently introduced stricter alcohol guidelines for England players.

title: Madras HC orders Udhayanidhi's release after questioning over 'vulgar' remark
Triple murder? 3 deaf-mute rag pickers found dead in rented room in UP
description: Three deaf and mute individuals were discovered deceased in a rented room. Police officials and forensic experts immediately arrived at the Gari Kala area scene. Initial investigations suggest a possible internal conflict led to their tragic deaths. The landlord and neighbors could not provide definitive identification for the victims. Further investigations are currently underway to determine the exact cause of death.

title: Flyers injured as Air India's Phuket-Delhi flight encounters turbulence
MNS sends toy Toyota Innovas to BMC commissioner over vehicle upgrade row
description: A controversial BMC proposal to replace its Scorpio SUVs with newer Toyota Innovas has drawn criticism. In protest, MNS leaders sent toy Innovas to the BMC Commissioner as a symbolic gesture. Opposition parties have challenged the funding and timing of the fleet refresh, while the ruling BJP maintains the change was a collective decision. Calls for retaining the Scorpios for uniformity in the fleet persist.

title: 'Go on hunger strike, face lathi, then I'll resign': Kharge Jr. on students' stir
description: Karnataka Home Minister Priyank Kharge defended police actions during protests over a recruitment exam. He stated authorities must maintain law and order for all candidates.  The minister's remarks about lathi-charge triggered a political dispute with the opposition BJP.  Candidates alleged irregularities, but the Karnataka Examinations Authority rejected these claims.  Kharge accused media of distorting his statements and warned of legal action.

title: From apps to 'intent': How AI agents will rewrite the way we use next‑gen phones
description: Smartphones are set to abandon their traditional app icon grids in favor of AI-driven interfaces. Instead of manually opening apps, users will communicate their intentions via voice or text to smart agents that handle tasks seamlessly. This groundbreaking shift heralds a new age of technology, where app stores could evolve into dynamic service registries for these advanced AI agents.

title: JeM suspects's terror trail: A girlfriend for honey-trap, a gamer for surveillance
description: In a significant development, the West Bengal STF is delving into a terror recruitment ring that is tied to Pakistan and is targeting youth via online channels. Allegedly, Hamim Mondal exploited social media and gaming sites to scout and assign roles to recruits. For instance, Arpita Sarkar met Mondal on Instagram, while Aditya Singh linked up through an online game.

title: Lauren Sanchez worked at waterpark; 40 years later, she takes luxurious ocean trips
description: Lauren Sanchez's career evolved from a teenage waterpark job to ocean conservation leadership. She recently explored the Galápagos Islands, highlighting shark importance for marine health. The Bezos Earth Fund supports significant conservation projects in the Galápagos Marine Reserve. This funding protects vital habitats and migration routes for numerous marine species. Sanchez's work now focuses on protecting vast Pacific waters and their ecosystems.
